items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

items.title: 雄忻高铁山西段全线接触网送电完成

items.title: 11月11日央行开展1870亿元隔夜逆回购操作

items.title: 11月11日人民币对美元中间价报6.7191 下调24个基点
items.summary: 中新网11月11日电 据中国外汇交易中心网站消息，中国人民银行授权中国外汇交易中心公布，2026年11月11日银行间外汇市场人民币汇率中间价为1美元对人民币6.7191元，下调24个基点。

items.title: 日本推动修订“安保三文件” 威胁地区和平稳定
items.summary: 日本政府“再军事化”动作不断。据日本方面消息，针对修订“安保三文件”，日本执政党自民党及其执政伙伴日本维新会10日举行首次工作层磋商。据悉，双方围绕当前安全保障形势，讨论了加强防卫和外交力量的方向。

items.title: 贵州省信访局原局长马磊被“双开”
items.summary: 中新网11月11日电 据贵州省纪委监委消息：经贵州省委批准，贵州省纪委监委对贵州省信访局原局长、省委社会工作部原副部长(兼)马磊严重违纪违法问题进行了立案审查调查。

items.title: 贵州省黔南州人大常委会原副主任朱奉余被“双开”
items.summary: 中新网11月11日电 据贵州省纪委监委消息：经贵州省委批准，贵州省纪委监委对贵州省黔南州人大常委会原党组成员、副主任朱奉余严重违纪违法问题进行了立案审查调查。

items.title: 保加利亚连环车祸致12死50伤 11日为全国哀悼日
items.summary: 中新社北京11月11日电 索非亚消息：保加利亚当地时间10日发生两起严重连环车祸，造成12人死亡、50人受伤。该国政府当天宣布11月11日为全国哀悼日，以悼念遇难者。

items.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

items.title: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics
items.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir revisits love, loss and political inheritance, offering a deeply personal defence of her family and its legacy.

items.title: Real Madrid's Vinícius Jr sends surprise message to boy who lost his legs in Sudan's war
items.summary: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

items.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
items.summary: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.
